name: flexsim-mcp
description: MCP server that drives Autodesk FlexSim headless from Claude
author: Motasem Albanna

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=bundle/server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundle.mjs && mcpb validate bundle/manifest.json && mcpb pack bundle dist/flexsim-mcp.mcpb
